parallelism.ratio_interpretation: Aggregate child wall-time per outer wall-time, approximately 1.7643 concurrent child-equivalents; not a matched serial-baseline speedup and not GPU utilization.
parallelism.scope: Saved host event-order and monotonic time only. Numeric windows exclude pre-ledger hashing/startup and unmetered cleanup tails. Precise Popen timestamps were not serialized.

cold_load_host_intervals.interpretation: 106 saved model-load wrapper host intervals total 13228.62 seconds, 46.45% of summed child elapsed or 49.52% of summed ledger elapsed. Summation includes simultaneous children and cannot be subtracted directly from outer wall-time.
cold_load_host_intervals.not_proven: These intervals do not identify GPU execution time, physical disk/cache reads, or a uniquely isolated loading bottleneck.

storage.interpretation: 15.9646 GiB is final output file sizes deduplicated by inode. 31.5054 GiB counts logical paths including aliases. Filesystem-reported allocated blocks total 16.1290 GiB. None is an exact global peak or actual physical I/O measurement.

usable_conclusions: This saved wave took 4.4843 hours and started 8 parents / 106 branches. Coverage was seven full 15-branch parents plus one normal-only parent; elapsed time is not an all-120-branch benchmark.
Saved evidence supports maximum parent concurrency 2. Numeric host windows overlapped for 10881.80 seconds; the saved parallelism summaries do not measure GPU utilization.

Every started branch performed a model cold load. The saved load wrapper accounts for 46.45% of summed child host elapsed, so any future throughput preparation should quantify this recurring cost without changing rollout semantics.

Final deduplicated output is about 15.96 GiB. Saved monitoring completed 3202 polls with no recorded monitor errors, but available filesystem samples do not establish project quota, a storage reservation, or future capacity.

recommendation.reason: This wave provides operational evidence at concurrency 2 only. It does not supply a matched concurrency-1 baseline, resource peaks, or evidence for scaling above 2.
recommendation.next_batch_requires: A new bounded release and scope/coverage accounting; consumed Batch1 release and unused caps must not be reused.
CPU_only_preparation_if_throughput_chang: Use saved timing fields to separate model-load wrapper, other startup, rollout and publication costs, with explicit clock scope and missing intervals.

Before proposing model reuse or reduced repeated loading, prepare a CPU-only semantic and accounting review covering per-branch state/RNG isolation, immutable checkpoint identity, reset behavior, resource caps and publication/cleanup.
Keep fixed source/seed selection and early-success eligibility unchanged; do not replace the normal-only parent to improve apparent yield.
Any concurrency increase or loader change needs a separately reviewed proposal; this review launches no added GPU experiment.

review_limits: Read only the three source files listed above. Did not scan experiment trees, read/hash weights, inspect hardware/processes, load models or run experiments.
First-parent V4 was not reopened because this review does not make a cross-workload or speedup comparison.
